title: Adding Service Parts starts Unassigned when the rep's switch is off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create staff member D for this test, active at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Create a customer for this test whose one Sales Representative is staff member D.
  • Then turn staff member D's "Sales Representative" switch off and save, so the customer shows staff member D's name followed by "(Inactive)".
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Click the + beside Sales Representative.
  2. Click "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  3. Save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The first field is renamed "Sales Representative - Service Labor".
  • It still reads staff member D's name followed by "(Inactive)".
  • "Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows under it reading "Unassigned".

Step 3:

  • The customer saves.
  • Its page lists "Sales Representative - Service Labor" with staff member D's name followed by "(Inactive)".
  • Its page lists "Sales Representative - Service Parts" with Unassigned.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 13 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R7: “Adding Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and shows "Sales Representative - Service Parts" under it. Both start with the person who was in the first field, or "Unassigned". When that person's Sales Representative switch is off or their account is deactivated, the first field keeps them, as "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)" (S4-N2), and the added Service Parts field starts "Unassigned".”
  • S4-N2: “Turning off a staff member's Sales Representative switch, without deactivating their account, leaves them in the customer fields they hold, as today. In Edit Customer and on the customer page their name reads followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)", as on the work order (S1-E2). They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”
  • S4-R27: “Only a staff member whose account is active and whose Sales Representative switch is on is copied (S1-R8). Anyone else leaves that field "Unassigned", and S4-R17 and S4-R18 still apply at invoicing.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026; answer 41, 23 Oct 2026), read 23 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 41: “41. (b) "Unassigned", and the same for an added "Sales Representative - Service Parts" field. A new field never starts with a person whose Sales Representative switch is off or whose account is deactivated (S4-R27). The field they already hold keeps them, reading for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)" (S4-N2). PRD v13, S4-R7 and S4-R8.”
